package.name: calibration_multi_cam
package.description: Multi-camera intrinsic + extrinsic calibration for ROS 2. Subscribes to a set of camera image topics defined in a central YAML, detects an AprilGrid target (kalibr-compatible layout), and solves per-camera intrinsics plus the rig extrinsics. The world frame is aligned with the first camera. Results are published as intrinsics-only sensor_msgs/CameraInfo (no R/P) and as the extrinsics over TF (and PoseArray). Algorithm follows ethz-asl/kalibr's kalibr_calibrate_cameras pipeline, reimplemented on OpenCV + scipy.
